title: Ontology Engineer
summary: Specialist who formalises semantic models as ontologies and ensures their logical consistency.
body_markdown:
# Ontology Engineer

## Purpose

Provide formal rigor where machine reasoning is required.

## Responsibilities

- Formalise concepts as OWL classes, properties and axioms.
- Run reasoners and consistency checks.
- Manage IRIs, namespaces and versioning of ontologies.

## Decision Rights

Formal semantic level: axioms and formal consistency, within approved meaning.

## Inputs

Approved definitions; semantic model.

## Outputs

Ontologies; consistency reports.

## Required Competencies

Description logics; OWL; RDF tooling.

## Escalation Paths

Meaning ambiguities → [[Semantic Architect]].

## Related Governance Processes

- [[Decision Rights Model]]
- [[Architecture Change Process]]
